pages.name: Three Quiet Knocks
pages.description: After the third knock, the furniture inside freezes, and a tiny copy of the room appears on the windowsill.

pages.name: Empty Window
pages.description: The light goes out. Only a dark, empty room remains behind the glass.

scenePatch.description: It is dark beyond the window, and no movement can be seen anymore.

pages.name: House Within a House
pages.description: The miniature room stays lit, and its furniture continues to move almost imperceptibly.
